summary.one_liner: A curated list of links to real-world engineering ladders (career frameworks defining engineering job levels and expectations) from companies and other sources.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style link list rather than software. It is organized into a "Real World" section with links to engineering ladder documents from Kickstarter, Dropbox, Rent the Runway, GitLab, and Etsy, plus a "Misc" subsection pointing to a sample collection of career ladders and a "30+ Engineering Career Ladders" resource. A "Resources" section is meant to hold frameworks, articles, books, videos, slides, and blogs, but most of those subsections currently say "To Be Updated," and only one framework link (Engineering Ladders for Engineering Managers) is listed. The README also has pointers to two related awesome lists: Awesome Engineer Onboarding and Awesome Engineering Team Principles.
use_cases: Finding example engineering career ladders from other companies
Drafting job levels and expectations for an engineering team
Comparing how companies define engineer, senior, and manager levels
notable: Collects engineering ladder documents from several named companies in one place
Includes a Rent the Runway spreadsheet of software development and leadership ladders
Links to a sample of career ladders compiled by a Netlify VP of Developer Experience
Cross-links to related awesome lists on engineer onboarding and team principles
caveats: Most Resources subsections (Articles, Books, Videos, Slides, Blogs) are empty placeholders marked 'To Be Updated'
Only a handful of entries are listed, and the README does not describe the linked documents beyond their titles
